shorts.title: Ranking The Silliest Science Experiment Fails 🤯

gemini.fixes:
1. **Rework the Hook and Cut Unrelated Footage (00:00–00:04):**
   * *What is seen:* At 00:00–00:01, a tiny, blurry preview of the #1 clip appears with redundant, overlapping text overlays (*"GUESS THE PHYSICS"* and baked-in captions reading *"AND IT STARTED BOILING"*). At 00:02, clip #5 immediately cuts to a low-energy comedy skit of a man talking in a lab coat rather than an actual science fail.
   * *What is heard:* A robotic voiceover asks *"Can you guess the physics before it fails? Five, too much speed, watch,"* which makes no sense alongside a skit about lab time.
   * *The fix:* Delete the 2-second teaser entirely and start instantly at 00:00 with full-screen, high-energy footage of a real, spectacular science experiment fail (like an unexpected chemical foam explosion or imploding barrel). Hook viewers within the first 1.5 seconds with an instant visual payoff rather than a talk
